title: Angels we have heard
lyrics_original: Angels we have heard on high
Him whose birth the angels sing;
Christ the Lord, the newborn King.

bible_verses.telugu: వెంటనే పరలోక సైన్య     సమూహము ఆ దూతతో కూడనుండి సర్వోన్నత         మైన స్థలములలో దేవునికి మహిమయు ఆయన కిష్టులైన మనుష్యులకు భూమిమీద సమాధానమును కలుగునుగాక అని దేవుని స్తోత్రము చేయుచుండెను.
bible_verses.english: Suddenly a great company of the heavenly host appeared with the angel, praising God and saying, 'Glory to God in the highest heaven, and on earth peace to those on whom his favor rests.'

bible_verses.telugu: ఆ దేశములో కొందరు గొఱ్ఱల కాపరులు పొల       ములో ఉండి రాత్రివేళ తమ మందను కాచుకొను       చుండగా
bible_verses.english: And there were shepherds living out in the fields nearby, keeping watch over their flocks at night.

bible_verses.telugu: సర్వభూజనులారా, యెహోవానుబట్టి ఉత్సహించుడి ఆర్భాటముతో సంతోషగానము చేయుడి కీర్తనలు పాడుడి.
bible_verses.english: Shout for joy to the Lord, all the earth, burst into jubilant song with music;

devotional.prayer_english: Lord God, thank You for sending Your Son and filling the world with the good news of His arrival. As the angels sang in the night sky, tune my heart to join their heavenly praise. Fill me with the joyful wonder of the shepherds so that my life echoes Your glory every day. In Jesus’ sweet and holy name, Amen.
devotional.prayer_original: Lord God, thank You for sending Your Son and filling the world with the good news of His arrival. As the angels sang in the night sky, tune my heart to join their heavenly praise. Fill me with the joyful wonder of the shepherds so that my life echoes Your glory every day. In Jesus’ sweet and holy name, Amen.
devotional.reflection_english: The angels’ song couldn’t be contained in heaven; it spilled over into the night sky, inviting humble shepherds and all creation to join in praise. When God entered our world through the gift of Jesus, heaven and earth burst into joyful worship. Today, as we lift our voices in 'Gloria,' we step into that same unending chorus. May our hearts echo this heavenly joy and welcome the Savior who brings true peace to our souls.
